name: GasLeakSurveyTracker
tagline: Grade, track and close every gas leak on time – with survey compliance built in.
description: A complete leak management app for gas distribution operators in one Power Apps code component: report leaks, grade them with built-in grading guidance, track Grade 1 / 2+ / 2 / 3 repair and re-evaluation deadlines, make Grade 1 leaks safe, schedule and record repairs, confirm with a post-repair check and keep leak survey compliance per survey area. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Grading guidance from reading, location, surface and distance
Repair, re-evaluation, grading and post-repair deadlines per grade
Crew work packs, compliance and summary JSON, CSV export
Roles: dispatcher, technician, compliance, supervisor, viewer
Demo mode, undo, phone layout, keyboard and ARIA
controlType: standard (GasLeakSurveyTracker data-set + GasLeakSurveyTrackerPortal field control, shared src/app)
